integrity: The proof is symbolic. The central finite-support closure construction was checked against the exact broad closure definition in the primary source and against the older ordinary-closure treatment of D and 4. No finite experiment, external certification, or independence claim is used.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to systems without modal inference rules and does not address T, B, or 5. The proof-consequence closure establishes completeness and the finite one-world countermodel property but is not claimed to yield an effective decision procedure or a complexity bound.
title: Serial consistency and positive introspection preserve one-world completeness in weak closure semantics
